name: Ethics, Politics, and Economics
about: Ethics, Politics, and Economics (EP&E) is an interdisciplinary major that draws on moral and political philosophy, political science, and economics. The major is designed for students who wish to combine training in these three fields in order to address complex social, political, and economic issues. Students in EP&E develop the analytical tools to understand and evaluate the ethical dimensions of public policy, political institutions, and economic systems. The curriculum integrates foundational coursework in ethics, political theory, microeconomics, and statistical methods, and allows students to pursue individualized programs of study through a flexible set of elective and seminar requirements.
